name: kxm
description: Headless multi-agent orchestration, durable workflows, and a live operator dashboard for Pi and Claude Code

server_url.title: KXM server URL
server_url.description: URL of the KXM hub (the operator starts it with kxm hub start)

auth_token.title: Authentication token
auth_token.description: Project token for this project from the hub KXM_PROJECT_TOKENS. Leave blank on the machine that runs the hub to use the project token the hub saved for this project. The hub admin token is never used

agent_name.title: Agent name
agent_name.description: Name other agents see. The first active session in a project keeps it; a later concurrent session registers as <name>-<pid>

agent_purpose.title: Agent purpose
agent_purpose.description: Short description used by peers when routing work
agent_purpose.default: Claude Code implementation and review agent

project.title: Project
project.description: Hub project key; must match a key in the hub KXM_PROJECT_TOKENS. Blank uses the package.json name, then the directory name
